subject: Vendor enrollment & remittance details for Meridian Health - PO prefix and test invoice
messages:
From: Kelly Murray <kelly.murray@meridianhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor setup: Redwood Inference (PO prefix / VAT handling)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. We're ready to add Redwood as an approved vendor in Meridian's AP system — a couple of configuration asks before we start: 

- Our PO system requires a vendor-specific PO prefix for invoice matching (we typically set a 3-4 letter prefix). Can Redwood accept "MER" as the PO prefix on your invoices?
- For US invoices we route payments to our lockbox (EFT preferred) and need bank remit instructions in the vendor record. For EU invoices we need VAT handling: Meridian prefers invoices that either include VAT ID + VAT amount, or indicate reverse-charge where applicable.
- We'll need a completed vendor enrollment form (attached) and a test invoice to validate line-level matching in our portal.

I'm attaching Meridian_Supplier_Form_Fill.pdf with the fields our portal requires. If you can send the completed form plus a sample invoice and your bank remit template, we can create the vendor record and issue a PO.

Timing: we'd like to get this complete before the next billing cycle (by 2027-07-12). Can you confirm?

Thanks,
Kelly Murray\AP Sourcing Manager\Meridian Health

Attachments: Meridian_Supplier_Form_Fill.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Kelly Murray <kelly.murray@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor setup: Redwood Inference (PO prefix / VAT handling)

Hi Kelly,

Thanks — we can meet the timeline. Quick confirmations:
- We can put "MER" in the PO reference field of our invoices so your matcher can pick it up. Please confirm whether the prefix should appear in the PO number (e.g., MER-PO-12345) or as a separate PO prefix field.
- For EU customers we support invoicing with VAT amounts or marking reverse-charge; we'll follow Meridian's preference per account.

I'll start the vendor enrollment flow. Attached: Redwood_AP_Packet_Meridian_v1.pdf (our standard AP packet), and a test invoice Redwood_Test_Invoice_0001.pdf formatted to your sample.

For some of the bank/remit specifics I need to loop in our Payments lead — copying our AP lead internally.

Best,
Karthik Iyer\Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Packet_Meridian_v1.pdf, Redwood_Test_Invoice_0001.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Meridian vendor setup — PO prefix, remit, lockbox, VAT

Team,

Customer wants Redwood added to Meridian's AP portal with the following constraints:
- PO prefix they requested: MER (they may want it embedded in PO number or as a prefix field).
- US payments via lockbox/EFT; they require bank remit details on the vendor record and prefer ACH with supplier name exact match.
- EU invoices may be reverse-charge in some jurisdictions; they want VAT ID present where applicable or an explicit reverse-charge note.
- They require a completed vendor form + a test invoice to validate line-level matching.

Action items:
- Ben: Confirm our bank remit template fields (ACH details, name matching rules, remit email or SFTP for remittance adv). Also — can we provide a lockbox routing string or only ACH/IBAN? If Meridian needs a lockbox postal route, we may need to accept checks to our bank lockbox or provide a third-party lockbox solution.
- Laura: Once bank fields are confirmed, can you update the AP packet and produce a signed supplier form copy for Meridian?
- Grace: If they insist on vendor-specific PO prefix in the PO number, are there any downstream billing or collection impacts we should surface (reporting, reconciliation)?

I want to be able to send them the completed form + a validated test invoice by EOD Wed (07/07).

Thanks,
Karthik

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Meridian vendor setup — PO prefix, remit, lockbox, VAT

Karthik — short answers below. See attached bank_instructions_template.pdf for the exact fields we populate in vendor records.

- ACH/Bank remit: We can provide full ACH (routing/account) and IBAN for EU. We do not currently accept paper lockbox deposits directly into Redwood; Meridian's lockbox would need to route ACH or we can provide instructions for a bank to convert checks to ACH via a processing partner if they insist on postal lockbox.
- Name matching: Our bank requires the account name to match the legal company name exactly (Redwood Inference, Inc.). For ERP matching we can include an alternate remit name field ("Redwood Inference - AP") that Meridian can use, but that must be consistent.
- Remittance adv: We can provide remittance advice via SFTP drop (CSV) or via emailed PDF to our remit inbox (remit@redwoodinference.com). SFTP preferred for automation — we'll create a temporary inbound folder for Meridian if needed.
- PO prefix: Embedding "MER" in the PO number is fine (e.g., MER-PO-12345). No system changes required on our side; we only need the PO reference to be passed through to our billing system so invoices can reference it.

I'll update the bank template with the legal name and sample fields. Attaching bank_instructions_template.pdf.

Ben
Director, Payments & Collections
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bank_instructions_template.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Kelly Murray <kelly.murray@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@meridianhealth.com>, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment & remittance details for Meridian Health - PO prefix and test invoice

Hi Kelly / Samir,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per the internal confirmations above, here is what Redwood can provide to get Meridian's vendor record validated and a PO issued: 

1) PO prefix: We'll include "MER" as a prefix in the PO number (example format: MER-PO-12345). Please confirm if your matcher expects it as a free-text prefix or as a discrete prefix field in the portal; either works for us but we want to mirror your exact field so line-level matching passes.

2) Bank / remit: Attached is our bank_instructions_template.pdf with ACH and IBAN examples. Our legal name must appear as "Redwood Inference, Inc." in the vendor record. Meridian can send remittance adv via SFTP (we can provision an inbound folder) or by email to remit@redwoodinference.com. If Meridian requires check lockbox processing, we can work with your bank to convert to ACH via a processor — let us know if you need that route.

3) VAT / EU handling: We will include VAT ID where applicable and can mark reverse-charge on invoices when requested. Please flag any jurisdictions where Meridian prefers self-billing or has a reverse-charge workflow.

4) Completed form & test invoice: Attached are the completed Redwood_AP_Packet_Meridian_v1.pdf (filled supplier form) and Redwood_Test_Invoice_0001.pdf (sample showing MER-PO-0001). Also attaching bank_instructions_template.pdf. Please use the test invoice to validate the portal mapping.

Next steps requested from Meridian:
- Confirm how you want the PO prefix represented in your portal (prefix field vs embedded PO number).
- Validate the test invoice and confirm the vendor record creation once complete.
- If you want SFTP remittance, confirm the host details and we'll provision an inbound folder and share credentials securely (DocuSign link for the vendor form is here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234-efgh-5678).

We'll stand by for confirmation and can hop on a 20-minute call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Karthik Iyer\Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Packet_Meridian_v1.pdf, Redwood_Test_Invoice_0001.pdf, bank_instructions_template.pdf
